name: Entity Reference Recursive Delete
description: Gives an alternative delete button for nodes with entity reference fields.
project_description:
What is this module? 
 This module adds a new entity operation which allows you to recursively delete entity references and their associated additional entity references.

 How does it work? 
 When editing an entity, there will be a recursive delete button at the bottom of the page which you can click on, to start the deleting process. You will be redirected to a list of entities connected to the entity you want to delete. Here you have the option to choose what should happen with the entity references and the items inside the entity references. If you check a checkbox here for the corresponding entity reference, that entity references item will be permanently deleted from the system. If you’re using this entity reference item elsewhere, and you intend to keep it there, don’t check the checkbox. If you are sure this entity references item is not used elsewhere, or you want to delete it everywhere, use the checkbox to do so.

 Features: 
 You can change and translation to the label of the delete button in Configuration->Content authoring->ERR Delete settings , and also hide the old delete button if needed.
